terms.definition: The attacking player who crosses the midline into the opponent's territory while chanting 'Kabaddi'.
Players in their own territory working together to tackle the incoming raider or avoid being tagged.
The continuous, clear, audible chanting of the word 'Kabaddi' without pause or breathing in.
A tackle executed by 3 or fewer defenders, earning 2 points instead of 1.
A single raid where the raider secures 3 or more points (through touches and/or bonus).
The 3rd consecutive raid without points by a team, where the raider must score or be declared out.
When an entire team is dismissed; the opposing team receives 2 bonus points and the dismissed team is revived.
An agile evasive move where a raider ducks low underneath an oncoming chain of defenders.
An athletic leap over defenders who attempt an ankle hold or chain block.
